programme.title: How China Plans to Turn Its Factories Green
programme.desc: The zero-carbon industrial park is one of China’s recent tactics to decarbonize its factories through renewable power. Can its nascent technology move China into a greener era of mass production?

programme.title: Can Microbes Solve the Copper Problem?
programme.desc: The global copper supply is on a collision course with growing electricity demand. Now some companies are turning to biomining, the process of using microbes to extract metals, to boost supply.

programme.title: Inside a Giant Electric Ferry
programme.desc: While electric vehicles have gone mainstream, shipping has lagged behind. But now, the humble passenger ferry may be the most primed to make battery-powered boats a viable option.

programme.title: AI Is Pushing Chipmaking to Its Limits
programme.desc: Semiconductors power modern technology, from AI to everyday devices. Now, global tensions and rising demand are forcing the chip supply chain to adapt.

programme.title: The Race to Fuel a Nuclear Energy Comeback
programme.desc: Nuclear power is attempting a comeback, but producing the necessary fuel is complex. From mining to enrichment, can new technologies and supply chains scale to power the next generation of reactors?

programme.title: The Amazon Divide
programme.desc: Brazil's deforestation rate is falling, but Bolivia's is accelerating. Bloomberg Originals investigates whether protecting forests in one country simply pushes development across the border.

programme.title: Why AI Is Sucking Up the World's Wealth
programme.desc: Bloomberg Originals unpacks how the artificial intelligence boom has resulted in a concentration of immense wealth, pushing global trade imbalances to levels unseen since the 2008 financial crisis.

programme.title: Artificial Intelligence Pioneer Fei-Fei Li
programme.desc: Emily Chang meets artificial intelligence pioneer Fei-Fei Li to discuss her innovations in the field, her $1 billion startup World Labs and why she thinks the future of AI lies beyond chatbots.

programme.title: Jennifer Doudna on CRISPR Gene Editing
programme.desc: Emily Chang meets Nobel Prize-winning scientist and University of California, Berkeley, Professor Jennifer Doudna to discuss the origins of CRISPR, other breakthroughs in gene editing and what Silicon Valley gets wrong about the future of biology.

programme.title: Inside America's Prediction Market Boom
programme.desc: Emily Chang hits the streets of New York with Tarek Mansour, who along with Luana Lopes Lara created Kalshi, the biggest prediction market in the world.

programme.title: Waymo's Bet on a Driverless Future
programme.desc: Emily Chang travels to San Francisco to meet Tekedra Mawakana, Waymo’s co-CEO. Chang asks Mawakana how a career overseeing technological pivots.

programme.title: The Rise and Reckoning of Jensen Huang
programme.desc: An inside look at Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang just weeks before he revealed an extramarital affair with a woman the US reportedly suspects to be a Chinese spy.

programme.desc: An inside look at Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang just weeks before he revealed an extramarital affair with a woman the US reportedly suspects to be a Chinese spy.

programme.title: Netflix (Part 1)
programme.desc: Emily Chang travels to Paris, Seoul and Los Angeles to explore Netflix's next chapter in the entertainment world.

programme.title: Waymo's Bet on a Driverless Future
programme.desc: Emily Chang travels to San Francisco to meet Tekedra Mawakana, Waymo’s co-CEO. Chang asks Mawakana how a career overseeing technological pivots.

programme.title: Artificial Intelligence Pioneer Fei-Fei Li
programme.desc: Emily Chang meets artificial intelligence pioneer Fei-Fei Li to discuss her innovations in the field, her $1 billion startup World Labs and why she thinks the future of AI lies beyond chatbots.

programme.title: Jennifer Doudna on CRISPR Gene Editing
programme.desc: Emily Chang meets Nobel Prize-winning scientist and University of California, Berkeley, Professor Jennifer Doudna to discuss the origins of CRISPR, other breakthroughs in gene editing and what Silicon Valley gets wrong about the future of biology.

programme.title: Alexander Stubb, President of Finland
programme.desc: Francine visits Finland, where the threat from Russia looms large. She speaks to President Alexander Stubb about Finnish resilience and how his country is preparing for an uncertain future.

programme.title: Ray Dalio, Founder of Bridgewater Associates
programme.desc: Francine Lacqua meets Ray Dalio on OceanX in the port of Nice for the UN Ocean Conference. They speak about radical transparency, building and leaving one of the largest hedge funds and what's next.

programme.title: How to Run Your Family's $1.6 Trillion Empire
programme.desc: Francine Lacqua talks with Franklin Templeton CEO Jenny Johnson about how to steer a $1.6 trillion business amid the rise of AI, shifting politics and booming private markets.

programme.title: WTO's Okonjo-Iweala on Why Globalization Needs a Rethink
programme.desc: Francine Lacqua speaks with Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala about fighting corruption, the personal cost of her work - including her mother's abduction - and leading the WTO through unprecedented trade tensions.

programme.title: How Blackstone Changed Private Equity Forever
programme.desc: Blackstone CEO Stephen Schwarzman helped private equity go from niche to mainstream. He talks about how he spots investment opportunities and where the world will shift next.

programme.title: Sunil Mittal on the Battle for India's Telecom Market
programme.desc: Francine meets Bharti Enterprises Founder Sunil Mittal to hear how he went from selling bicycle parts to navigating a "relentless" battle for control of India's telecom market.

programme.title: Tesla's Dangerous Doors
programme.desc: A number of fatal car crashes involving Tesla vehicles has prompted increased scrutiny of its electric doors, triggering lawsuits over whether the design can leave passengers trapped.

programme.title: The Race to Challenge China's EV Lead
programme.desc: Chinese companies dominate the EV battery supply chain and are expanding rapidly outside their home market. Meanwhile, competitors are looking to new chemistries to leapfrog the leading tech.

programme.title: The Race to Merge AI With Humanoid Robots
programme.desc: Humanoid robots that use AI are going mainstream, but they're far from proven. With billions of dollars invested, can they deliver real-world value or will they fall short of the hype?

programme.title: How Ethiopia's Gas-Car Ban Sparked an EV Boom
programme.desc: Ethiopia became the first country to ban imports of gasoline-powered cars in 2024. Today, its EV share outpaces the global average, but the road ahead is uncertain. Can Ethiopia’s bet on EVs pay off?

programme.title: Inside the Race to Upgrade Transformers
programme.desc: Transformers are critical to the power grid, but the rise of renewables and surging energy demand are pushing them to their limits. Could the solid-state transformer meet these new challenges?

programme.title: Can Microbes Solve the Copper Problem?
programme.desc: The global copper supply is on a collision course with growing electricity demand. Now some companies are turning to biomining, the process of using microbes to extract metals, to boost supply.

programme.title: How China Plans to Turn Its Factories Green
programme.desc: The zero-carbon industrial park is one of China’s recent tactics to decarbonize its factories through renewable power. Can its nascent technology move China into a greener era of mass production?

programme.title: Inside a Giant Electric Ferry
programme.desc: While electric vehicles have gone mainstream, shipping has lagged behind. But now, the humble passenger ferry may be the most primed to make battery-powered boats a viable option.

programme.title: How High Speed Traders Made Billions in India
programme.desc: In India, high-frequency trading firms have earned billions of dollars in the derivatives space while retail investors faced record losses. Is HFT fueling efficient markets or gaming the system?

programme.title: The World's Most Profitable Subway
programme.desc: Hong Kong’s MTR is the most profitable subway in the world thanks to a lucrative real estate strategy. Now it’s taking on record debt for a government-mandated tech hub with uncertain demand.

programme.title: China's Controversial $167 Billion Mega-Dam
programme.desc: In one of the most earthquake-prone regions on Earth, where the Tibetan Plateau meets the Himalayas, China is building a colossal hydropower system, pushing engineering and geopolitics to the limit.

programme.title: Why AI Is Sucking Up the World's Wealth
programme.desc: Bloomberg Originals unpacks how the artificial intelligence boom has resulted in a concentration of immense wealth, pushing global trade imbalances to levels unseen since the 2008 financial crisis.

programme.title: Bloomberg Surveillance Radio
programme.desc: The economy and the markets are "under surveillance" as we cover the latest in finance, economics and investment. Join Tom Keene, Paul Sweeney, Lisa Mateo, Michael Barr and other guests.

programme.title: Bloomberg Intelligence

programme.desc: To get closer to the secret formula, Plankton swaps bodies with Squidward and must learn to adapt to his new lanky form. // Sandy teaches SpongeBob cowboy skills while they pan for bubbles, unaware that Krabs trails them on the hunt for treasure.

programme.title: Patrick-Man! / Gary's New Toy
programme.desc: Patrick becomes the superhero Patrick-Man, who intends to clean up Bikini Bottom-whether it wants it or not. // Gary becomes obsessed with his new red ball, forcing SpongeBob to take drastic measures to intervene.

programme.title: Parrot pickle / On the Campaign Tail
programme.desc: Hope charms a flock of parrots guarding a fig tree and they make her their leader. // It's School President election time and the Twins are running against each other and Bibi!

programme.title: Houballoween / Rosa is fired
programme.desc: The Twins Halloween Movie night takes a spooky turn when the Marsups are mistaken for spirits by their friends. // Rosa's fired by the Mayor when she arrives with her mother to utter chaos and mess.

programme.title: Zoo U / A Remembrance of Grand-Past
programme.desc: The Star family goes on a college tour for Patrick... at the zoo. // GrandPat shares his life stories to spoil every movie at the theater.

programme.title: Pat-Tathlon / Upturn's Downturn
programme.desc: The Patricks compete in a series of games for control of the TV remote. // After driving over Patrick, a court order forces Lady Upturn to live with the Star family.

programme.title: Neptune's Ball
programme.desc: The star family visits King Neptune's palace.

programme.title: Pablum Plankton / MuseBob ModelPants
programme.desc: Plankton wins a "cutest baby" contest and becomes the face of a baby food brand. // When Squidward's one-off portrait of SpongeBob takes the art world by storm, he has no choice but to produce more.

programme.title: Not So Fast and Furious
programme.desc: A new super-fast villain is wreaking havoc in Secret Shores, and Billy is the only hope at tracking her down. After Billy's speed accidentally triggers an avalanche, however, he decides to hang up his cape and retire from being a superhero.

programme.title: Alien Zoo
programme.desc: When Danger Force becomes the newest exhibit at an Alien Zoo, Miles must find a way to break them out before they become alien dinner.

programme.title: Budget Cuts
programme.desc: When the Vice Mayor cuts Captain Man and Kid Danger's budget to build a high speed railway in Swellview, Captain Man and Kid Danger must figure out creative ways to save money.

programme.title: Study Muffin / Homespun
programme.desc: Lincoln gets a tutor that all his sisters instantly get crushes on, making it impossible for Lincoln to study. // The kids complain about their house, but when a tornado threatens to destroy it, they start to feel differently.

programme.title: Intern for the Worse / The Old and the Restless
programme.desc: Tensions run high when Lincoln and Clyde both get an internship at Flip's and compete to win the manager title. // When Lincoln sees how tame Pop Pop has gotten in his older age, he takes him out for a day to remember.

programme.title: Ruthless People
programme.desc: When the house is infested with termites, half the family stays with Pop Pop and the others with Aunt Ruth.

programme.title: Drive Happy / Old Man Patrick
programme.desc: SpongeBob can't drive, but you don't need a license to operate a self-driving car! // Patrick thinks he's an old man, so it's up to SpongeBob to remind him how much fun being a kid can be!

programme.title: Fun-Sized Friends / Grandmum's the Word
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick exchange tiny living versions of themselves. It's a whole hunk of homunculus fun! // Plankton tells his Grandma that he owns the Krusty Krab, but must keep the lie going when she comes to visit.

programme.title: Abandon Twits
programme.desc: The Krusty Krew builds a boat for their penny-pinching captain.

programme.title: The Barbarian Next Door / Runaway Patrick
programme.desc: After Pat The Hapless moves in next door, Patrick and SpongeBob help him find a job. // GrandPat convinces Patrick to run away from home.

programme.title: FitzPatrick
programme.desc: Patrick's evil twin cousin shows up to ruin Patrick' reputation.

programme.title: Parrot pickle / On the Campaign Tail
programme.desc: Hope charms a flock of parrots guarding a fig tree and they make her their leader. // It's School President election time and the Twins are running against each other and Bibi!

programme.title: A Bug's Strife / All the Rage
programme.desc: Dad tears the house apart trying to find the cricket ruining his peaceful day alone in the house. // Tired of getting pummeled during dodgeball, Lincoln and the gang use Clyde's untapped rage without him knowing.

programme.title: Summer Camp: The Grate Outdoors / Summer Camp: Don't Lose Your Cool
programme.desc: At Camp Mastodon, Lynn pushes an overly-cautious Lisa to become more adventurous. // When Lori learns her Camp Mastodon campers think she's uncool, she tries to impress them by breaking the rules.

programme.title: Director's Rut / Friday Night Fights
programme.desc: Luan turns to Mr. Coconuts for help after she struggles to direct her school's play. // Lisa joins Lynn's football team as the analytics coach to prove that math will always beat out heart.

programme.title: Spy Dames / Cupid's Harrow
programme.desc: During Grandparent's Day at Lincoln's school, he and Myrtle face off with a spy nemesis from Myrtle's past. // Leni accidentally causes trouble for Lori and Bobby while taking calls on her and Miguel's dating podcast.

programme.title: BassWard / Squidiot Box
programme.desc: Squidward and Bubble Bass are forced to tolerate each other's company on a trip to Jetsam City. // Squidward takes a trip inside the imagination box and must rely on SpongeBob and Patrick's creativity in order to escape.

programme.title: Gary & Spot
programme.desc: Sandy narrates the nocturnal adventures of Gary and his secret pal - Spot.

programme.title: Thanks But No Thanksgiving
programme.desc: The Stars celebrate Thanksgiving with Bunny's side of the family in Klopnod.

programme.title: At Home, On the Lam
programme.desc: Bunny must punish Patrick for chocolate-flavored crimes.

programme.title: Earth Day Games
programme.desc: The Twins really want to win the Earth Day Games at school.

programme.title: Rosa is fired

programme.title: Meet the Purrents / Apartment Complex
programme.desc: When Lori and Bobby find a kitten, they decide to coparent and swap the kitten back and forth between their homes. // After telling her family how great her apartment is, Lori unknowingly entices her sisters to secretly take over her space.

programme.title: Spatula of the Heavens

programme.title: Making Waves / Captain Quasar: The Next Iteration

programme.title: She's All Splat

programme.title: Cave the Date

programme.title: iBloop 2: Electric Boopaloo

programme.title: Brain Squeezers
programme.desc: Tori is selected to be the team captain for a new game show, Brain Squeezers. She has to choose 3 teammates to compete with her, and quickly becomes overwhelmed by requests from the gang.

programme.title: Fami-Lay-Lay Reunion
programme.desc: The family is hosting Bryce's relatives for the annual Alexander family reunion. Sadie is finally old enough to help in the kitchen. Lay Lay is convinced that a friend of the family's named Ray Ray is an avatar, just like her.

programme.title: The Taunting Hour / Musical Chairs

You are OK, I am OK, the variety show is OK!

programme.title: Love without End(1961)
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin...

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must combine their deadly kung fu styles to overthrow the tyrant and avenge their fallen empire.

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddha's Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world...

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the ‘Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the director/writer's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong's caught in the Mong's territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Ping's limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Wealthy heir Ping Chien Jen spurns the family business for a travel agency with his girlfriend Su Yung Lan. While they are hosting visitors from Hong Kong, a student falls for Chien Jen, sparking tension. Consumed by jealousy, Yung Lan storms off, and the student crashes her car after learning of his engagement. Misunderstandings are eventually cleared, and happiness follows.

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: Qing enforcer Luo Yi Hu murders rebel Chen Gui, forcing his wife and daughter Xiao Wei to flee to Guang Long Town. There, mischievous Jia Yu discovers his master's identity as a rebel while helping Xiao Wei. After his loved ones and mentor are killed, Jia Yu sheds his playful ways and seeks vengeance, facing the Qing forces in a final battle.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Three rookie constables refuse to collude with corrupt officials, making themselves targets of a deadly conspiracy. After losing comrades and witnessing the abuse of power, they abandon all hope of justice. Determined to avenge the fallen, they launch a bloody assault on the corrupt forces in a desperate fight for justice.

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Tales of a Eunuch
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao inadvertently enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi, whilst covertly serving rebels seeking the sacred “Sutra of Forty-Two Chapters”. Caught between rival factions when the Emperor seeks it too, Xiao Bao must rely on his quick wit and cunning to survive the perilous court and evade danger.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: The Adulteress

This is the story of the origin of bums, guts, jaws and super-hearing, and a 500-million-year chain of innovation, survival and hunger.
